description: This is a Python source file implementing advanced distributed tensor operations and module management for Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) in PyTorch, including mesh initialization, module ignoring policies, parameter/state management, and device handling.

classes.name: FSDPMeshInfo
classes.description: Data class containing information about the FSDP mesh configuration.

classes.name: HSDPMeshInfo
classes.description: Data class representing hierarchical shard device mesh info with mesh and dimension specifications.

classes.name: DeviceMesh
classes.description: Represents a multi-dimensional device mesh for distributed tensor placement.

methods.name: FSDPMeshInfo|None _get_post_forward_mesh_info( reshard_after_forward: bool | int, mesh_info: FSDPMeshInfo )
methods.description: Determines the appropriate device mesh info to use after a forward pass, based on resharding parameters.

methods.name: DeviceMesh _init_default_fully_shard_mesh()
methods.description: Initializes a default device mesh, either on GPU or CPU, for fully sharded tensor operations.

methods.name: torch.device _get_device_from_mesh(mesh: DeviceMesh)
methods.description: Returns the torch.device object corresponding to the provided device mesh.

methods.name: bool _ignore_module( module: nn.Module, ignored_params: set[nn.Parameter], ignore_decision: dict[nn.Module, bool], )
methods.description: Decides whether a module can be safely ignored during sharding based on buffers and parameters.

methods.name: list[nn.Module] _adjust_managed_modules( modules: list[nn.Module], ignored_params: set[nn.Parameter] )
methods.description: Filters managed modules, removing those with all parameters ignored.

methods.name: list[nn.Module] _get_managed_modules( root_modules: tuple[nn.Module, ...], ignored_params: set[nn.Parameter] | None = None, )
methods.description: Recursively collects modules that are managed for FSDP, excluding nested or non-composable ones.

methods.name: None _verify_managed_param(name: str, param: nn.Parameter)
methods.description: Validates that a parameter can be managed by FSDP; scalar tensors are not supported.

methods.name: tuple[list[nn.Parameter],list[torch.Tensor]] _get_managed_states( modules: list[nn.Module], ignored_params: set[nn.Parameter] | None = None )
methods.description: Retrieves all parameters and buffers that are managed for FSDP from a list of modules.

methods.name: None _move_states_to_device( params: list[nn.Parameter], buffers: list[torch.Tensor], device: torch.device, )
methods.description: Moves model parameters and buffers to the specified device, with handling for special tensor types.
